scope: Review findings 2-5, bounded quota aggregates and combined route/policy reads. Synthetic configurations, ledgers and loopback upstreams only.

reference.before: Exact Python source snapshot before these fixes; includes the earlier generic API label changes. Separate venv points at this snapshot and the same dependency installation.
reference.after: Current uncommitted Python source, including fixes 2-5 and combined route/policy reads; original sequential durable persistence retained.
reference.relay_process_isolation: The relay collector strips PYTHONPATH in child processes. The baseline therefore uses a separate interpreter with a .pth source entry; the final run uses the development interpreter.

screening_experiments.note: 80 pairs per mode are diagnostic samples, not budget acceptance. Parallel receipt/database persistence was discarded because improvements were not stable.

validation.installation: Wheel installed in an isolated temporary venv and verified outside the repository; imports resolve to the installed package. Personal installed service was not updated.

installed_concurrency.scope: temporary loopback upstream only; no real credentials or generations

limitations: Nonstream p95 overhead remains 11.8172 ms against the unchanged 10 ms target; strict budget validation exits 1.
Cold quota admission, eviction and invalidation still require a full daily allocation scan; the 10,000-row cold sample was 115.470 ms.
The 100,000-row Dashboard scenario selects an empty recent window; it does not measure a 100,000-row active window.
Small relay latency differences are subject to host and filesystem variance; stream completion p95 increased from 11.7227 to 12.0352 ms.
